research_answers.10_feature_before_wider_sweep: Yes. A bounded online-scale mechanism plus an additional explanatory input for model/secondary-path behavior should be designed before a wider GPU/model sweep. The current minimal matrix already separates scale drift from shape failure.
research_answers.1_recompute_transfer: The frozen recompute curve does not transfer numerically to either new condition: C-load raw MAPE 46.370% and C-model 47.834%. Both become low-residual under a single scalar (3.381%, 4.864%), so recompute is scale-sensitive rather than fixed.
research_answers.2_cpu_restore_transfer: CPU restore also fails fixed transfer (37.919% C-load, 38.997% C-model raw MAPE) but is well described by one scalar (3.020%, 2.814% residual).
research_answers.3_machine_memory_pcie_numa: Issue #15 did not vary machines, GPU, PCIe topology, or NUMA placement, so no cross-machine transfer claim is supported. Capacity did matter for restore validity: 14B CPU p4096 required the logged 24 GiB correction, and the 2 GiB filesystem staging path failed partially at p4096.
research_answers.4_secondary_path_specificity: Filesystem behavior is tier-specific. Under C-load it is scale-like (5.204% residual), while under 14B/C1 it is shape/missing-feature limited (35.600% residual) and has an invalid long-token restore.
research_answers.5_concurrency_scale_vs_shape: The first qualifying load shift is C2. Relative to the same-session C1 sentinel, recompute changed 91.982%, CPU restore 62.153%, and filesystem restore 70.693%. All three C-load curves are repaired by one scalar, supporting load-dependent scale rather than shape failure.
research_answers.6_fixed_parameters: The external-token coordinate, tier separation, workload identity, and decision formula remain useful fixed structure. The Issue #14 absolute latency curves are not globally fixed outside C0.
research_answers.7_online_calibrated_parameters: At minimum, bounded runtime/environment scale is required for recompute and CPU restore outside C0; C-load filesystem is also scale-sensitive. The diagnostic scalar is evidence for the need, not a production calibration.
research_answers.8_low_cardinality_runtime_observations: Useful low-cardinality observations are runtime external KV tokens, source tier, concurrency/load identity, model identity/model class, transfer bytes/counts, restore allocation validity, and bounded environment/path scale observations.
research_answers.9_low_confidence_systematic_error_region: Filesystem short-token extrapolation at external 104-168 is low-confidence; the 104-token decision is wrong in both new conditions. The 14B filesystem curve is additionally systematic shape failure, and p4096 is invalid.

stop_decision.reason: The two pre-registered new conditions distinguish scale-sensitive transfer from a secondary-path shape/missing-feature failure. A broader GPU/model sweep would not resolve the missing-feature design first.
